v1.1.0.description:
- Added the 32 hats as checks.
- Now includes a new save file to use (GCN only for now), that starts from the Woods and has every single collectible in the four intro levels available to get (especially useful for potential future expansion).
  - You'll be expected to use an in-game cheat code that unlocks every level, which must be done every time the game is started.
- Added Increased Damage, Increased Healing, and Instant Power Golf as items you can receive. You can then activate them using their cheat code inputs (must be done on every game boot).
v1.1.0.title: v1.1.0 (Hat Update)

v1.1.1.description: - Renamed level unlock items from "Keys" to "Heist Plans" to make better thematic sense.
v1.1.1.title: v1.1.1

v1.2.0.description:
- Added checks for all 200 cookies, 200 chips, 97 DVDs, and all minigame levels.
- Added shuffle settings for minigames, hats, cookies, chips, and DVDs.
  - Warning: Cookies/Chips/DVDs will add a LOT of Spuddies to the item pool.
- Improved the save file so you no longer ever need to input the cheat codes that unlock all levels/minigames (they are still included in the readme just in case for documentation purposes).
- Added sort-keys for proper location ordering.
v1.2.0.title: v1.2.0 (Major Collectibles Update)

v1.2.1.description:
- Improved and simplified a lot of location naming.
- Improved sort-keys so that cookies, chips, DVDs, and hats are listed in the order (or close to it) that you'd encounter them, rather than each item category taking turns. Should be much easier to track now.
v1.2.1.title: v1.2.1
